children: Overview
UK travel retailer's Q4 group revenue grew 4% yr/yr
Full-year headline group pretax profit expected to miss analyst expectations
Profit margins impacted by increased promotions, reduced marketing, and inflation headwinds
Outlook
WH Smith expects full-year headline group profit before tax of about £75 mln
Company anticipates year-end net debt of around £325 mln and leverage of 2.0x
Company cites inflation headwinds and increased promotional activity as factors impacting margins
Result Drivers
PROMOTIONAL ACTIVITY - Increased promotional activity contributed to lower trading profit margins
INFLATION HEADWINDS - Inflation pressures negatively affected profit margins
PORTFOLIO RATIONALISATION - Store closures and market exits in Rest of the World division aimed to improve profitability and cash generation
